VegetationChronologyTable.Rd

植生経年変化表　(粗表)

VegetationChronologyTable(
  plot_name = plt$plot_name,
  vt = VT,
  vtDK = VTdk,
  period = c("dk01", "c02", "c03", "c04", "c05")
)

Arguments

plot_name

vector of a plot name or plots names

vt

a tibble (or data.frame) of vegetation table

vtdk

a tibble (or data.frame) of vegetation table

Examples


VegetationChronologyTable()
